description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Track a new protocol. Scored immediately from live GitHub + DeFiLlama data.

Use when a protocol you care about is not tracked yet and you want it scored from live GitHub and DefiLlama data. Not for reading an existing score.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

treasury_address.description: Optional. On-chain treasury address to score (Etherscan balance).

name: protocol_health_track_protocol
